Returns the last node allocated in the slot pass.

When the slot list was non-empty, prepend by writing the old head this+0x10 into the new node's next link (node[1]).
When the slot list was empty, set this+0x14 = node and this+0x18 = node.
Set the slot list head this+0x10 = node.
Increment the slot count at this+0x1C.
Return the last node allocated by the slot pass; the caller ModelSceneFileLoader (004b6c90) uses this to grow the allocator.
